gaps: Primary vendor datasheet hosts (vishay.com, ti.com, infineon.com, onsemi.com, docs.arduino.cc, espressif.com, raspberrypi.com, adafruit.com, kingbrightusa.com, omron, bourns) are blocked from this container (DNS/proxy 403). Values were read from web-search extracts of mirrors (RS, Farnell, alldatasheet, university copies) and distributor listings. Every 'high' value should be re-checked against the primary PDF before the catalog ships; I could not do that here.

LEDs: each datasheet gives only one (Vf, If) point, so the ideality factor n = 2 and Rs = 0 are assumptions (low). If_max(DC), Vf_max (red, white) and VR_max were not retrieved. InGaN blue/white need Rs or a larger n for a realistic slope. A second I-V point from the datasheet curves is needed per LED.

Light domain payload is undefined in PLAN. Emitters need on-axis intensity (cd), beam half-angle and a spectrum class. Sensors (LDR, BPW34) need illuminance at the sensor (lx). That requires a new 3D binding (E = Iv*cos(phi)/d^2 between the LED optical-axis anchor and the sensor-face anchor, inside the beam). BPW34 responsivity is specified at 950 nm and illuminant A, so the spectral mismatch with visible LEDs is unmodelled.

Data domain needs typed payloads: bool, number, PWM duty (0..1), pulse width (us, servos), ADC counts, and text (LCD 16x2). HC-SR04 needs a new binding source (raycast along the sensor axis to the nearest surface within a cone). PLAN 12.1 only lists anchor distance.

State and hysteresis: relay pick-up/drop-out, microswitch movement differential, Schmitt-like GPIO input bands and the solenoid valve's open/closed dp condition all need the previous state carried in session state between steady-state solves. The component interface (PLAN 11.1) should allow per-instance solver memory.

Actuators that 'hold position' (servos, steppers, geared 28BYJ-48) are piecewise constraints with a torque limit (complementarity-like). The MNA solver needs a mode-switching element (or a regularised stiff spring with saturation). The simulation never moves parts, so servo/stepper commands can only drive a ghost or indicator plus a position-error result. This needs a product decision.

Mechanical rotational and translational ports need a reference terminal (housing/frame). The library format must map them to 3D: shaft/plunger sub-body plus a pre-created revolute/prismatic mate to the body, so bindings can read the angle/position and the gravity torque or force.
Coulomb friction (motors), stall and diode exponentials need tanh/regularisation and junction-voltage limiting (pnjlim) in the Newton loop. The LED Is values of ~1e-30 A demand it.

Fluid domain: air (fans) and water (pump, valve) share the Pa / m^3/s units. Nets should carry a medium tag so a fan cannot be wired to a pump. The Adafruit 997 valve flow coefficient (Kv) and the R385 pump curve are not published (pump values are from seller pages only, low). Fan curves are linearised between shut-off pressure and free-air flow, with affinity scaling vs voltage assumed.

Solenoid force vs stroke F(x) is unknown; only the start force (6 N) is published. Adafruit 413 coil data conflicts (12 ohm, which implies ~1 A, vs '~250 mA'). Adafruit 412 start force conflicts (0.5 N vs 5 N). The return-spring constant is unknown.

Microcontroller boards: UNO idle current is not officially specified. The Pico current (18 mA) and 3V3_OUT (300 mA) come from secondary sources. RP2040 GPIO thresholds were not retrieved. ESP32 GPIO drive strength was only found for the ESP32-S2. The DevKitC LDO part, header row spacing and the UNO/ESP32 regulator dropouts are unknown. GPIO output resistances are derived from VOH/VOL test points (worst case).

Missing driver/companion blocks that real projects need: a bipolar stepper driver (A4988/DRV8825/TMC2208) for the NEMA 17, an L298N/TB6612 motor driver, an opto-isolated relay-module variant, a fuse, a capacitor/inductor (steady state: open/short), and an 'I2C LCD backpack'.

Mass properties: these components are not homogeneous, so the library schema needs an explicit mass plus COM override (density x volume is wrong for motors and batteries). Sourced masses: AA 23.0 g, 9V 45.6 g, 18650 43.8 g typ, FA-130 ~17 g, SG90 9 g, MG996R 55 g, solenoid 144 g, valve 121.9 g, Nano 7 g, UNO 25 g. Unknown: NEMA17 17HS4401, 28BYJ-48, fans, pump, relay module, LCD, LM2596 module (seller value 11.23 g), resistor, LED.

3D model coverage: KiCad kicad-packages3D master is now STEP-only (1974 .step, no .wrl). It covers passives, semis, switches, the SRD relay, buzzer, LDR, connectors, the WC1602A LCD and the Pico. Some KiCad footprints reference STEP files that are absent (HTTP 404 verified): Arduino_UNO_R3_WithMountingHoles, Arduino_Nano_WithMountingHoles, Potentiometer_Alps_RK09K_Single_Vertical, Osram_DIL2. FreeCAD-library covers SG90, 28BYJ-48, NEMA17-40, HC-SR04, the 40 mm fan, Nano and a Freaduino UNO. Parts that must be procedural or newly modelled: MG996R, FA-130, PTV09 pot, BPW34, solenoid, pump, valve, LM2596/relay/ULN2003 boards, ESP32-DevKitC board, 80 mm fan, batteries.

Licensing for a downloadable library. A redistributed collection of KiCad models falls outside the KiCad design exception, so it must ship as CC-BY-SA-4.0 with attribution and LICENSE.md. FreeCAD-library is CC-BY-3.0, with per-part authors found only in git history (manual audit needed). NopSCADlib is GPL-3.0: use it only as a source of dimensions (facts) and never copy its code. Raspberry Pi Pico design files carry a permissive grant (preferred). The licence of Arduino's official CAD files was not verified. Vendor STEP files (TowerPro, Mabuchi, Sunon, Noctua, Adafruit) are generally not redistributable, which is why those parts are procedural. Avoid trademarks and logos (Arduino, Raspberry Pi) on generated geometry.

Build pipeline: STEP to GLB conversion (occt) must run offline at library build time. It must also handle Z-up to Y-up, KiCad's footprint-origin/PCB-plane convention, and splitting moving sub-bodies (plungers, sliders, levers, horns, shafts) so that mates and bindings can attach.

Part variability: SG90, MG996R, 28BYJ-48, HC-SR04, 1602A LCDs, LM2596 modules, R385 pumps, TMB12A05 buzzers and '130' motors are widely cloned and their specs differ by vendor. Each library item should state which part it represents and allow per-instance parameter overrides. The PN2222A (E-B-C) and P2N2222A (C-B-E) pinouts must be a selectable variant (pinout from memory, low).

Unverified or low-confidence values to resolve before shipping: SS-5GL operating force (0.49 vs 1.47 N), pretravel and movement differential; B3F travel; PTV09 rotation angle (280 vs 300 deg); SRD pick-up/drop-out; 2N2222A BR/NE/V_CEO/I_C; LM7805 tolerance (2.5 % vs 4.8-5.2 V) and Iq (8 vs 5 mA); thermal resistances (theta_JA) for TO-220 rating warnings; 9V battery R_int is a 1 kHz impedance, not a DC resistance; AA capacity is rate-dependent; 18650 OCV curve; LDR gamma column ambiguity.

Transient-only behaviour is ignored in steady state: relay operate times, servo speed, stepper pull-in rates, PWM (treated as average duty), LED/LDR response times, solenoid duty-cycle heating. The PLAN asks to keep the interface open for a later transient phase.
